critical_code_review_comments: scouting.py:198 — de-dupe within a (category, level_group, sub_category) tuple is not applied on POST create_skill; a coach could add two skills with the same name in the same slot. Not a regression, existed before this iter. Consider adding a normalized-name uniqueness check (mirrors the bulk-import dedupe path).

scouting-skills.tsx:172 — persist() sends sub_category='' for stunting/jumps (correct); but for tumbling it derives sub from anchors and defaults to '' when a skill sits directly under the Level divider (before any subdivider). In practice buildRows always inserts a subdivider so this branch is unreachable, but a defensive fallback to 'standing' would prevent bad data if a coach drops a skill above the first subdivider via drag.
